notes: Repriced all 18 physical grenades around in-world manufacturing complexity, electronics, legality, scarcity, and delivery technology rather than damage output or Mk alone.

Conventional utility and fragmentation grenades are relatively cheap mass-produced munitions, while Sticky/Homing, EMP, Recon, Biohazard, and exotic ordnance carry large technology and access premiums.
Canonical grenade migration updates both FEHA priceCredits and dnd5e system.price.value on existing world and owned grenade items, and refreshes the displayed grenade card price.
